mapper.sql: currency_centers.id AS id, currency_centers.`name` AS `name`, currency_centers.symbol AS symbol, DATE_FORMAT(currency_centers.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(currency_centers.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy
FROM currency_centers LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = currency_centers.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = currency_centers.modified_by

WHERE currency_centers.is_active = 1
AND currency_centers.`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO currency_centers( `name`, symbol, photo, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{currency.name}, #{currency.symbol}, #{currency.photo}, NOW(), #{currency.createdBy}, #{currency.isActive} );
